claude-code.reason: Plugin hooks run automatic maintenance and transcript capture at session boundaries.
claude-code.policy_hook_reason: hooks/hooks.json registers a blocking PreToolUse policy hook for every tool.

cursor.reason: Cursor hooks run the shared lifecycle at session start and stop.
cursor.policy_hook_reason: hooks/hooks-cursor.json registers a preToolUse policy hook for every tool.

vscode.reason: The extension performs automatic maintenance, but generic VS Code exposes no agent transcript lifecycle.
vscode.policy_hook_reason: Verified 2026-11-05: official VS Code agent hooks are Preview only (format/behavior may change); do not claim a stable policy_hook. Copilot Session Target in VS Code is covered by the separate copilot host (.github/hooks). Citations: https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/agent-customization/hooks (Preview note) · https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/customization/hooks · https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/hooks-reference (CLI/cloud; not a VS Code GA contract).

codex.reason: Trusted Codex plugin or repository hooks run the shared lifecycle at SessionStart and Stop.
codex.policy_hook_reason: Codex plugin (.codex-plugin/hooks/hooks.json) and repository setup (integrations/codex/hooks.json → .codex/hooks.json) register PreToolUse; plugin hooks require trust.

opencode.reason: The OpenCode plugin runs shared lifecycle maintenance on normal chat turns.
opencode.policy_hook_reason: .opencode/plugins/agentic-swe.js registers tool.execute.before and throws when the policy hook exits non-zero.

antigravity.reason: Workspace hooks run maintenance on PreInvocation and capture on Stop.
antigravity.policy_hook_reason: integrations/antigravity/hooks.json registers PreToolUse with decision JSON deny/allow.

windsurf.reason: Cascade hooks run maintenance and transcript capture when Restricted Mode is disabled.
windsurf.policy_hook_reason: integrations/windsurf/hooks.json registers pre_run_command, pre_write_code, pre_read_code, and pre_mcp_tool_use (exit 2 blocks).

kiro.reason: Kiro v1 SessionStart and Stop hooks run the shared lifecycle.
kiro.policy_hook_reason: integrations/kiro/agentic-swe-memory.json registers a PreToolUse command hook (exit 2 blocks).

copilot.reason: Copilot CLI and coding-agent hooks are covered; IDE chat transcript lifecycle is not exposed consistently.
copilot.policy_hook_reason: integrations/copilot/agentic-swe.json registers preToolUse with permissionDecision deny JSON and exit 2.
